[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided 10 healthy breakfast ideas that can be prepared in advance:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Overnight Oats: Mix rolled oats, milk, nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar and refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Muffin Tin Frittatas: Whisk eggs, milk, and diced veggies, pour into muffin tins, bake, cool, and refrigerate or freeze.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Breakfast Burritos: Scramble eggs, cook sausage or bacon, add cheese, black beans, and veggies, wrap, and refrigerate or freeze.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Cottage Cheese Parfait: Mix cottage cheese with fruit, nuts, and honey in individual containers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chia Seed Pudding: Mix chia seeds with milk, refrigerate overnight, and top with fruit and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Breakfast Quesadillas: Fill tortillas with scrambled eggs, black beans, cheese, and veggies, cook, cool, and refrigerate or freeze.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Green Smoothie Packs: Freeze fruits, spinach, and milk in bags for easy blending in the morning.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Cinnamon Roll Oatmeal: Cook oatmeal with cinnamon and sugar, refrigerate or freeze portions, and reheat.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Veggie and Cheese Scramble: Scramble eggs with diced veggies and cheese, refrigerate or freeze portions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Mason Jar Granola: Mix rolled oats, nuts, and seeds with oil and honey, refrigerate or freeze portions.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in overnight oats and breakfast burritos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided detailed ingredients for Overnight Oats and Breakfast Burritos.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Overnight Oats Ingredients: 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia seeds (optional), 1 tbsp honey or maple syrup (optional), pinch of salt, and toppings (fruits, nuts, seeds, coconut flakes, cinnamon
